title: Inspect an installation plan without acquiring or changing files
actor: A project user evaluating an installation or replacement
goal: Understand the planned destination scope, preliminary conflicts, and checks that have not yet run without downloading or modifying the project.
context: The user needs to assess the consequence of installation before allowing its actual effects.
trigger: The user requests a dry-run for the selected supported target.
preconditions: A supported target request and available bundled inventory identify the preliminary scope.

interaction.action: Requests a nonmutating plan, including any intended force choice.
Reports planned units, preliminary conflicts and replacements, and which archive or destination checks remain unperformed.
Uses the bounded plan to decide whether to request a real installation.

expected_outcome: The user obtains an honest preliminary plan without acquisition, extraction, or project mutation and cannot mistake it for verified installed success.

alternatives.outcome: The result describes whole-unit replacement and its local-change consequences without performing it.

failures.condition: The request uses a removed target, adapter syntax, or state-writing option.
failures.outcome: It rejects before acquisition or mutation even in dry-run mode.

failures.condition: The available inventory cannot establish the planned scope.
failures.outcome: The system reports that limit rather than presenting a complete verified plan.
